description: Create a forward rule on an inbound inbox. Received messages matching all `conditions` (none = every message) are forwarded to the `destinations`.

conditions.description: Conditions that must all match. An empty array matches every message.

operator.description: Comparison operator. `empty` and `not_empty` are only valid for `header` conditions.

value.description: Text to compare against. Required for every operator except `empty` and `not_empty`.

destinations.description: Addresses to forward matching messages to.

inbox_id.description: The inbox ID to create the forward rule in.

name.description: Rule name. Must be unique within the inbox.

name: create-inbound-forward-rule
